name: application-thread-collapse
title: Thread Collapse
description: Email-style quoted-reply chain where older messages collapse to a one-line summary bar that expands individually, with an Expand all control, and the newest message always shown in full.
useWhen: Showing a long email reply chain where only the newest message needs to be fully visible by default.
You want per-message disclosure plus a single control to expand every collapsed message at once.
Distinct from Comment Thread, which shows nested replies with avatars and always-visible bodies rather than a collapsed quoted-email chain.
avoidWhen: Showing a discussion/comment thread where every reply should stay visible — use Comment Thread instead.
The thread only has one or two messages — collapsing adds no value.
responsiveBehavior: Collapsed rows truncate their preview text with an ellipsis rather than wrapping, keeping each row a single line regardless of width.
accessibility: Each collapsed message is a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its expanded content region.
The disclosure chevron rotates to reflect expanded state, reinforcing the aria-expanded value visually.
"Expand all" is a normal focusable button, keyboard-operable without needing to open each row individually.

variants.title: Thread Collapse
variants.description: Two collapsed prior messages with sender/preview/date, an Expand all control, and the newest message shown in full.
accessibility: Collapsed rows are buttons with aria-expanded="false" and aria-controls until toggled.

variants.title: Thread Collapse (Dark)
variants.description: The same thread adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Row and preview text contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
